$comment: Deck slides at 1920 by 1080, built from the image layouts (brand/assets/image.json): the hero for the cover and statement, the numbered cards for bullets and cards, the window for an image, the quote window, and plain slides for a section, a stat and the end card that use the same grounds, scanlines, band, lockup and type. Sample copy is the brand's own site and editor copy; the quote is a sample attributed to Acme.

sample.title: How to safely share your users’ cards with an agent
items:
Save it once, not in the chat
Your user adds their card a single time. It’s stored encrypted, never pasted into a conversation.

The agent never sees the number
It asks to buy. The card pays at checkout.

Every purchase is approved
With a passkey, Face ID or their voice, tied to that exact cart.

It’s still their card
Points land as usual. Disputes go through their bank.
